theme.title: From Tip to Buzzer
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: The chart shows wins for four other West No. 1 seeds. How many regular-season games did the 2022–23 Nuggets win?
questions.note: Denver's first No. 1 seed ever, and the start of its first title run.

funFacts.text: Denver clinched the Western Conference's top seed for the first time in franchise history in early April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On April 5, 2023, the Nuggets clinched the top seed in the Western Conference for the first time in franchise history.

funFacts.text: The Nuggets swept the Lakers in the Western Conference Finals to make their first NBA Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Nuggets made the Finals for the first time in history by sweeping the 7th seeded Los Angeles Lakers

funFacts.text: The title ended a 47-season wait in the NBA; Denver had also never won a championship in its ABA years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 2022–23 Denver Nuggets season was the 47th season for the franchise

questions.prompt: Chris Paul went 14 for 14 from the field in a 2022 playoff game. In Game 2 of the 1991 Finals, Jordan made how many shots in a row?
questions.note: Including the famous mid-air hand switch, as Chicago evened the series and never lost again.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jordan would hit his next 13 shots in compensation

funFacts.text: Putting Scottie Pippen on Magic Johnson was the key defensive switch.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The biggest decision of the game was putting Scottie Pippen on Magic Johnson

funFacts.text: The Lakers had won the opener in Chicago before the Bulls responded in Game 2.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Game 1  | June 2  | Los Angeles Lakers  | 93–91 (1–0)  | Chicago Bulls

funFacts.text: Marv Albert's call from that series became one of his most iconic.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: one of Albert's most iconic calls

questions.prompt: The 1987 Lakers lost one game in the West playoffs, when Sleepy Floyd scored how many in Oakland?
questions.context: 1987 West semifinals · Game 4 · Warriors vs Lakers
questions.note: 51, sparing Golden State a sweep; it was the only game the 1987 Lakers lost in the West.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Their only loss was a Sleepy Floyd 51-point outburst in Game 4 in Oakland

funFacts.text: The Lakers swept Denver in the opening round, starting their Western playoff run without a loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: they swept the Denver Nuggets in the first round

funFacts.text: Floyd's outburst allowed Golden State to avoid a second-round sweep.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: which allowed the Warriors to avoid a sweep

funFacts.text: Michael Cooper set a playoff mark with six made three-pointers against Boston in the Finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He hit six 3 pointers, a playoff record

questions.prompt: The chart shows other season-opening winning streaks. How many games did Allen Iverson's 2000–01 Sixers win to start their season?
questions.note: The start of a run to the East's best record and Philadelphia's first Finals since 1983.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The 76ers won their first ten games of the regular season

funFacts.text: Philadelphia had built a 36–14 record by the All-Star break before its midseason roster overhaul.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: later on held a 36–14 record at the All-Star break

funFacts.text: Starting guard Eric Snow missed a large chunk of the season with a stress fracture in his right ankle.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: only played just 50 games due to a stress fracture in his right ankle

funFacts.text: The Sixers reached a 42–14 record at one point but went 14–12 over the rest of the regular season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: At one point, the team's record was 42–14, but finished 14–12 the rest of the way

questions.prompt: Kobe Bryant once made a then-record 12 threes in a game. In his 2001 playoff duel with Iverson, how many did Vince Carter hit in one half?
questions.note: A playoff record for one half. Vince finished with 50 points.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Most three-point field goals made in one half: 8

funFacts.text: He made eight consecutive threes during the game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: one game: 8

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: playoff game: 50

funFacts.text: The burst came against the Philadelphia 76ers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 11, 2001, vs. Philadelphia 76ers
